cause_claim: The change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader, which causes meta-store.rows_visible_to_builder to increase from 140 (baseline) to 280 (candidate). This is because the meta-store now counts rows visible to svc_bundle_reader from both the default database (140 rows) and the shard database r0 (140 rows), as both contain the bundle_fields table with 140 columns. However, all downstream functional metrics remain unchanged: bundle-builder.entries stays at 140, worker-runtime.loaded_entries stays at 140, and worker-runtime.exit_code stays at 0. The per-principal query limits and audit logging now apply to the shard database access, which was the change's intent, without breaking the bundle-building pipeline.
